mentions.name: resume.fail
mentions.description: A site offering paid resume/CV feedback delivered as recorded video reviews. Users buy the reviewer's time directly (no AI involved), and a form asks for an example job description so the review can play the role of the person doing the hiring. Reviews work for English-speaking applicants, preferably in digital-related fields.
mentions.source_excerpt:
After reviewing a few people’s CV’s the easiest format was for me to record a video with the feedback, so I put a site together for that:

https://resume.fail/

No AI, you just buy my time.
